subject: Operations
title: Autonomous Vehicles in Logistics
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Autonomous Vehicles in Logistics.

hook.text: A self-driving truck delivers goods from Dallas to Houston at 3 AM. No driver fatigue. No rest stops. Just freight.

buildup.text: Autonomous vehicles promise to transform logistics by reducing labor costs, accidents, and delivery times.

discovery.text: Self-driving trucks, delivery drones, and autonomous forklifts are being piloted across warehouses and highways.

twist.text: Full autonomy is years away for complex environments. Most current systems still need human backup for edge cases.

climax.text: TuSimple and Waymo are running autonomous freight routes on US highways—commercializing the first use cases.

punchline.text: Self-driving logistics is arriving—just not all at once.

quiz.question: What is the main promise of autonomous logistics vehicles?
